stories.title: Clubhouse Leader
stories.detail: Scott McLachlan is the competition leader on 37 pts, the one card everybody else is measuring themselves against.

stories.title: Scoreboard Bully
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers straight - someone else's problem now

stories.title: Someone Call Security
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 15 & 7 - the handicapper has questions

stories.title: Absolute Menace
stories.detail: 2 big ones on holes 17 & 3 - the rest of us should consider going home

stories.title: Cool It Down
stories.detail: 3 in a row on holes 10, 11 & 12 - is this even legal?

stories.title: Logjam
stories.detail: 3 tied at the top on 37 - countback territory

stories.title: The Charge
stories.detail: Turned it on - 18 coming home vs 10 out

stories.title: Three-Point Frenzy
stories.detail: 269 three-pointers across the field - the course is giving them up

stories.title: Family Affair
stories.detail: Tom and Brendan have turned the card in for the Shumack household, and nobody is conceding anything.

stories.title: The Bolter
stories.detail: Climbed 18 places - the mover of the day

stories.title: Welcome to WWCC
stories.detail: Great to see Desmond Glen Royal make the trip over from Thurgoona GC for a hit with us.

stories.title: Low-Marker Masterclass
stories.detail: Off the stick (2) and 7th - proper ball-striking

stories.title: Short-Hole Assassin
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 4 of the par 3s - the short holes never stood a chance

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 17, 3-pointer on hole 18 - that's better

stories.title: Textbook Stuff
stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 14-18 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 15-18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: The Merchant
stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ on the card - all over the card in the best possible way

stories.title: Building Something
stories.detail: 3 twos on holes 16, 17 & 18 - the round is taking shape

stories.title: Vanilla Golf
stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 14-18

stories.title: Spot Fires
stories.detail: 3 3-pointers+ scattered through the round - keeps finding ways to score

stories.title: Open for Business
stories.detail: 5 3-pointers+ from 18 holes - finding the scoreboard everywhere

stories.title: The Golf Tax Strikes Again
stories.detail: 3-pointer to 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18 - the course always takes its cut

stories.title: Hero to Zero
stories.detail: 3-pointer then a wipe on holes 17 & 18 - feast then famine

stories.title: On Cruise Control
stories.detail: A run of 8 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.title: The Full Experience
stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.title: Finding a Rhythm
stories.detail: 3 twos on the bounce on holes 2, 3 & 4

stories.title: Wipe Artist
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 18 holes - technically a very consistent performance

stories.title: The Complete Package
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s AND 3s - a round that covers all four food groups

stories.title: Committed to the One-Pointer
stories.detail: 10 1-pointers - every hole is a 1-pointer and that is the plan

stories.title: Not Today, Scoreboard
stories.detail: 4 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.title: Brief Interruption
stories.detail: Back-to-back wipes on holes 13 & 14 - we'll pretend this didn't happen

stories.title: The Points Drought
stories.detail: 8 wipes from 18 holes - officially requesting emergency services

stories.title: Faded to Grey
stories.detail: 15 on the front, 4 on the back - flew out then ran out of legs

stories.title: The Streaker (Not That Kind)
stories.detail: 4 wipes in 16 holes - tough day at the office

stories.title: Plot Hole
stories.detail: 2 wipes on holes 10 & 11 - the scorecard disagrees with the player

stories.title: Variety Pack
stories.detail: Wipes, 1s, 2s, 3s - something for everyone on this card

stories.title: Slipping Away
stories.detail: Percentage took a hit as Dean Cooper went 1st to 9th, but the season is far from over.

comingLast.roast: finished with 20 - the blue balls are one countback from home
he can still pass O'Connell - stranger things have happened, rarely to him
2 from 2 - do it for the car keys
the blue balls are patient - 6 holes is nothing to them
at 1.3 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
current run rate 1.4 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
averaging 1.4 a hole - the blue balls are warming up
with 2 to play and 2 in hand, boring golf is beautiful golf
a 2-point moat between him and O'Connell's crown - shallow moat
the buffer reads 2 - his group reads it aloud each tee
